metadata.chapter: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES

content.title: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES — Sec. 94-3. - Cellar doors, vaults, etc., in streets and sidewalks.
content.summary:
No person shall keep or permit to be left open, out of repair, insecure or unguarded
               any cellar door, grating or other covering of any coalhole, cellar or vault in any
               street or sidewalk.
(
Ord. No. 4098, § 2, 11-19-2007
)
